hand-fed squabs require 1.5% of their body weight of slurry per day from hatching to about 7 days of age, and 1% of their body wt of slurry from about 7 days to 28 days.

the optimum protein and metabolizable energy levels for hand feeding incubator hatched squabs are as follows: from hatch to 7 days, 53.3%, 3,675 ME; from 7 to 21 days, 21%, 3,200 ME; and from 21 to 28 days, 18%, 2,900 ME.

the optimum diet for hand feeding squabs from hatches to 7 days of age contained about 61% CP.
the optimum diet for squab hand feeding from 0 to 28 days is a slurry containing 25% of the optimum diet and 75%, water, and that the ME and CP requirements are 3,200 and 20%, respectively.

the protein and energy requirements of handfed squabs can be met by diets that are much lower in protein and energy than the diets fed to chicks.
